name: Liquid Corner
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia' and ice climbs End of the Line and Lovely Parting Gifts. Hike up the ridge on the North side of Peskett Canyon Drainage.
notes: A long corner system about 200m right of the canyon entrance. Developed in 2020.

name: AA
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia' and ice climbs End of the Line and Lovely Parting Gifts. Hike up the ridge on the North side of Peskett Canyon Drainage.
notes: Adventurous multi-pitch line on the Solar Panel. Developed in 2020.

name: Energizer Bunny
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia' and ice climbs End of the Line and Lovely Parting Gifts. Follow yellow flagging tape for 20 minutes to the creek.
notes: Starts 50m lower than Batteries Not Included. Developed in 2020.

name: Voltzwagen
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia' and ice climbs End of the Line and Lovely Parting Gifts. Hike up the ridge on the North side of Peskett Canyon Drainage.
notes: Start up and right of Batteries Not Included. Developed in 2020.

name: Batteries Not Included
approach: Park as for 'Little Russia', hike up the North side of Peskett Canyon Drainage following yellow flagging tape to Mt. Elliot creek.
notes: Multi-pitch sport route featuring sustained slab and exposed traverses.

pitchesBreakdown.description: Scramble up to the top of the pinnacle clipping two bolts to a chain station.
Stay under bolts and trend left to gain a groove.
Up and trend left through a small choss band into the groove.
Follow the weakness to a bolted station.
Fun traverse left through a balancy crux.
Climb straight up to a large treed ledge with a bolted station.
Climb up and left with hidden first bolt; slab gradually gets harder.
Straightforward slab through loose rock to a station in the yellow bay.
Exposed traverse left, clip a bolt, commit to hard moves through the crux.

name: Zardoz
approach: Park in pullout 7.4km from Cline River Bridge. Walk back ~100m, cross creek, follow trail up bluff on South side.
notes: Technical multi-pitch sport climb on razor-sharp limestone with sustained face climbing.

pitchesBreakdown.description: Clip first bolt and pull an awkward move on short slab.
Climb up and right on wall above waterfall, pull rotten flake.
Move your belay station left to a big warm ledge.
Technical face climbing on razor-sharp limestone.
All points off jug-to-jug dyno under the overhang.
Climb face to little ledge, pull through steep face onto positive wall.

name: Star Struck
approach: ~500m east of 'From Nordegg With Love' via ferrata. Hike across base and gain ridge buttress.
notes: Long alpine-style multi-pitch route across varied rock quality and bulges.

pitchesBreakdown.description: Start up broken rock, pull bulge, follow bolts left to ledge.
Follow bolts trending left to a ledge under two small bulges.
Pull first crux bulge and trend left to second crux bulge on amazing rock.
Follow bolts trending left on prickly rock.
Sparse bolts up easier terrain to slanting ledge.
Head up trending right to a ledge.
Head left clipping bolts with a 3-finger pocket crux.
Head up clipping bolts on good rock to a nice ledge.
Head out left clipping a bolt, walk across slope to waterfall base tree.
Climb right side of waterfall, cross it just below the lip.

name: Dumbo
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs and follow red flagging tape up.
notes: Enjoyable multi-pitch slab route with distinct scoop features.

pitchesBreakdown.description: Textured slab following bolts trending left to a ledge.
Fun flat 'elephant ear' scoop feature with lie-back style.
Go left off the belay past a short bulge over a cruisey slab.
Cruise black and white water runnels on juggy terrain.

name: Wet Like Willy
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs and follow red flagging tape left.
notes: Classic textured slab line utilizing water runnels.

pitchesBreakdown.description: Textured slab following bolts.
Move up and right to gain runnel for 10m, follow bolts left.
Traverse right without gaining elevation to top station.

name: Susan's Pollution Solution
approach: Park at Windy Point, cross Highway 11 at Lookout Slabs, starts 5m left of Wet Like Willy.
notes: Short multi-pitch slab route on Lookout Slabs.

pitchesBreakdown.description: Smooth slab becoming textured to a chain anchor bay.
Straight up over a steeper slab section to a bolted belay.
Easier ground to an awkward belay stance.

name: Kuzco's Poison
approach: Abraham Slabs on Mt. Abraham, ~5 mins east of David Thompson Resort (cairn at 52.244542, -116.439119).
notes: Technical multi-pitch route featuring roof cruxes and water runnels.

pitchesBreakdown.description: First pitch of The Groove to 2-bolt anchor.
Second pitch of The Groove to huge plateaued treed ledge.
Tricky committing cruxes to a roof with incut crimps.
Roof with deep pockets into opposing water runnels.
Layback and stem water runnels to ledge system.

name: The Emperor's New Groove
approach: Abraham Slabs on Mt. Abraham, ~5 mins east of David Thompson Resort.
notes: Classic multi-pitch line on Abraham Slabs with technical roof movements.

pitchesBreakdown.description: First pitch of The Groove.
Second pitch of The Groove to huge ledge.
Textured slab to tricky roof with incut holds.
Textured slab transitioning to water runnels.
Cruisy slab with water runnel laybacks and shallow pockets.

name: Berta Boy
approach: Owen Creek trail from Highway 11 park sign, follow trail ~45m-1 hour to upper right crag.
notes: Climb slightly overhanging naturally pocketed line with good rests.

name: Fenrir's Revenge
approach: Owen Creek trail up to Mythos crag.
notes: Climb vertical wall using pockets and edges as pump builds.

name: Medusa's Esophagus
approach: Owen Creek trail up to Mythos crag.
notes: Climbs main flow through rock chasm on left end of crag.

name: Blood Atonement
approach: Owen Creek trail up to Mythos crag.
notes: Stick clip 2nd bolt, climb over first roof, fight pump to get over final crux roof.

name: Yggdrasil
approach: Owen Creek trail up to Mythos crag.
notes: Climb steep pillar, get screws in, and commit out to hanging curtains.

name: The Hand of Fatima
approach: Owen Creek trail up to Mythos crag.
notes: Climb wildly overhanging corner feature with delicate feet.

name: I Am Eagle
approach: Drive 50m west of Lookout Slabs Parking, park at (52.25406, -116.40214), follow trail uphill for 7 minutes.
notes: Short, easy beginner line on left side of Happy People Crag.
